gaps: Whizz LA: the $139/mo figure exists only in Google's indexed page title; the live page renders an app shell. Unknown whether LA is a live market, delivery-only service, or a demand-test landing page. No LA address, weekly price, deposit, or plan table captured. Needs headless-browser scrape or a test signup in the Whizz app with an LA zip.
Whizz SF: SF-specific monthly/weekly price not captured (only national 'from $179/month'); Google review count for 1231 Stevenson St store and Trustpilot count not captured.
Zoomo LA: current status unverified. Site's LA URL serves NYC content with a single NYC store; no closure press found. Zoomo LA Facebook page exists but was not read.

No e-moped / e-motorcycle rental or subscription company targeting LA couriers was found in this pass (Revel, Dance, JOCO, Ryde returned no LA results; not individually verified). The competitor set surfaced is pedal-assist e-bikes (Whizz, Zoomo, Wombi) and peer-to-peer gas scooters (Riders-Share, FriendWithA) - HMP's FLASH/Lightning class may have no direct LA competitor, or one that search does not index.
LA-local independent e-bike/scooter shops advertising weekly rentals to delivery riders: none surfaced by search; needs Google Maps / Yelp query in DTLA, Koreatown, Westlake zips.
Informal Craigslist / OfferUp / Facebook Marketplace weekly e-bike rentals in LA: not surfaced by search; requires manual listing scrape.
Fleet sizes: only Whizz 2,500 (company-claimed, June 2024, national, mostly NY/NJ). No LA- or SF-level fleet figures for any competitor. Do not infer from review counts.
Battery-swap competition in CA: Whizz swap cabinets exist only in NYC, DC, Philadelphia; Storm-2 All-in not offered in SF. No LA battery-swap competitor found.
Repair/replacement policy detail captured only for Whizz; Zoomo 'Full Maintenance' inclusions and theft liability not captured.
must_ask_hmp: HMP's current SF rental price list by model (weekly/monthly), deposit, and rent-to-own terms - needed to benchmark against Whizz SF (from $179/mo, $99 deposit weekly, $99 buyout after 12 months) and Zoomo NYC ($20-$65/week).
HMP's SF unit economics per rented vehicle: utilization, monthly repair cost, theft/loss rate, replacement frequency - no public source substitutes for this.
Any inbound LA demand signals: SF riders who relocated to LA, LA web/app traffic, DMs, or DoorDash/Uber contacts asking about LA.
Whether HMP has or is negotiating a DoorDash/Uber fleet-partner or Dasher-discount arrangement comparable to Whizz's '$250 off first five months' program.
HMP's battery-subscription pricing and swap-station economics (~300+ subscribers) - to compare against Whizz's $49/mo NY swap add-on and to decide whether swap is a defensible LA differentiator.
Any direct intel on Zoomo's former LA operation (staff, former customers, why it wound down) or on Whizz's LA activity (riders who tried it).
surprises: Whizz appears to have NO physical Los Angeles location: its locations page (Sept 2026) lists 31 shops across 6 cities with a single CA hub in SF (1231 Stevenson St, Suite 101, 94103), and its DoorDash guide updated 2026-07-22 lists cities served without LA. The LA '$139/mo' page is an app-shell. CONTEXT's assumption of an established Whizz LA presence is not supported by Whizz's own site.
Whizz's advertised LA price ($139/mo, indexed title) is BELOW its national headline ($179/mo) and below its 2023 price ($159/mo) - either LA is a promotional/test market or the page is stale.

Zoomo's US web presence has collapsed to a single NYC store; its LA city URL serves NYC content. US pricing fell from Flex $49/wk / RTO $279/mo to 'from $39/week', a '$20/week' Uber Eats special, and '$790' outright purchase - price ceilings for pedal-assist courier e-bikes are lower than the 2022-2024 baseline.

Whizz's 'all-in' positioning is narrower than the name implies: included maintenance is tubes, brake pads, and adjustments with a $9 service fee per visit; all other parts are extra; theft liability is capped at $500 (with Protection Plan $19/mo). This leaves room for a genuinely full-service repair/replacement offer.
Wombi (LA, from $135/mo) is a Tern cargo/commuter subscription for consumers, not couriers - not a direct competitor despite appearing in LA e-bike subscription searches.

Whizz 2024 press: 2,500-bike fleet with >$8M ARR and total funding $20M (all company-claimed) - a venture-backed competitor roughly 25x HMP's ~100 whole-vehicle rental base, but concentrated in NY/NJ.
